replacement_value: CANNOT_MEASURE: exact source-audit action completion timestamp was not captured by a prospectively bound authoritative clock receipt
reason: The stored timestamp is a coarse artifact field and may be temporally plausible, but no pre-action clock receipt binds it to the research action. It therefore cannot establish prospective chronology. Preserve the source audit and classify the exact action timestamp as CANNOT_MEASURE rather than inferring precision from the field or from Git commit time.
allowed_use: Git commit timestamps may be used as repository-materialization chronology only; they do not retroactively prove pre-action research chronology.
supersedes_same_run_commit_note: The immediately preceding version of this correction overstated the clock inference by calling the stored value invalid. This replacement narrows the claim to the supported authority boundary; Git history preserves that repair.
